class.name: DisNetwork
class.brief_description: Sends and receives DIS (IEEE 1278.1) PDUs over a UDP socket.

method.name: get_effective_destination_port
method.description: Returns the UDP port outgoing packets are sent to: [member destination_port] if it is greater than 0, otherwise [member port].

method.name: get_send_address
method.description: Returns the IPv4 address outgoing packets are sent to, as set by the last successful [method start]: [member destination_address] in broadcast and unicast modes, [member multicast_group] in multicast mode. Returns an empty string before the first start.

method.name: get_statistics
method.description: Returns packet counters since the node was created or the last [method reset_statistics], as a [Dictionary]: - [code]received[/code]: datagrams read from the socket. - [code]sent[/code]: datagrams sent successfully. - [code]rejected[/code]: packets that were too short or could not be decoded (see [signal packet_rejected]). - [code]ignored[/code]: PDUs dropped by the exercise or own-packet filter. - [code]injected[/code]: packets passed to [method inject_packet]. - [code]multicast_interfaces[/code]: [PackedStringArray] of the interface names joined in multicast mode (empty otherwise).

method.name: inject_packet
method.description: Handles [param bytes] as if they had just been received from [param sender_ip]:[param sender_port], without touching the socket. It works while the network is stopped. [DisPlayer] uses it to replay recordings into the scene. Injected packets are not passed to recorders. If [param filtered] is [code]true[/code], [member filter_exercise] and [member ignore_own_packets] apply; otherwise every packet that decodes is emitted.

method.name: is_running
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the socket is open.

method.name: poll
method.description: Reads and dispatches all waiting packets now, up to [member max_packets_per_frame]. This is done automatically every frame while the node is in the tree (outside the editor); call it manually only in tests or tools. Does nothing if the network is not running.

method.name: reset_statistics
method.description: Sets the counters returned by [method get_statistics] to zero.

method.name: send_bytes
method.description: Sends [param bytes] unchanged as one datagram to [method get_send_address] on [method get_effective_destination_port]. Returns [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_UNCONFIGURED] (and prints an error) if the network is not running, [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_CANT_CONNECT] if the send fails, otherwise [constant @GlobalScope.OK].

method.name: send_pdu
method.description: Encodes [param pdu] and sends it with [method send_bytes]. [param pdu] must be an object with an [code]encode()[/code] method returning a [PackedByteArray], such as [DisEntityStatePdu]; if it has an integer [code]exercise_id[/code] property, that is set to this node's [member exercise_id] first. Returns [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_INVALID_PARAMETER] if [param pdu] is [code]null[/code] or has no [code]encode()[/code], otherwise the result of [method send_bytes].

method.name: start
method.description: Closes the socket if open, then opens it on [member port] bound to [member bind_address] and prepares sending according to [member mode]. In multicast mode it joins [member multicast_group] on every routable IPv4 interface (or only on [member multicast_interface]) and enables multicast loopback. Returns [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_CANT_OPEN] if the port cannot be bound, [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_CANT_CONNECT] if no interface could join the multicast group, otherwise [constant @GlobalScope.OK]. Errors are also printed.

method.name: stop
method.description: Leaves any joined multicast group and closes the socket. Called automatically when the node exits the tree.

members.member: Application number of this simulation (0 to 65535). Together with [member site_id] it identifies packets sent by this application so that [member ignore_own_packets] can drop them. Give every simulation on a network a different site/application pair.
If [code]true[/code], [method start] is called when the node is ready (not in the editor).
Local IPv4 address the socket binds to. [code]"*"[/code] or an empty string binds to all interfaces.

IPv4 address packets are sent to in [constant MODE_BROADCAST] and [constant MODE_UNICAST]. Ignored in multicast mode, which sends to [member multicast_group]. [b]Note:[/b] On Windows with several adapters (VPN, WSL), [code]255.255.255.255[/code] may leave through the wrong adapter; use the subnet broadcast address such as [code]192.168.1.255[/code].
UDP port packets are sent to. [code]0[/code] means the same as [member port].
Exercise ID (0 to 255). [method send_pdu] stamps it on outgoing PDUs, and with [member filter_exercise] incoming PDUs with a different exercise ID are ignored.
If [code]true[/code], received PDUs whose exercise ID differs from [member exercise_id] are dropped and counted as [code]ignored[/code] in [method get_statistics].

If [code]true[/code], received PDUs whose sender ID matches [member site_id] and [member application_id] are dropped (counted as [code]ignored[/code]). This removes the echo of our own broadcast or multicast traffic. The sender ID is read from the first 4 bytes of the body of Entity Information, Warfare, Radio Communications, Simulation Management and Simulation Management with Reliability PDUs; other families are never treated as own.
Maximum number of datagrams read per call to [method poll]. Remaining packets wait for the next frame.
How the network sends and receives. See [enum Mode].
IPv4 multicast group joined and sent to in [constant MODE_MULTICAST].

Name or IPv4 address of the network adapter used in [constant MODE_MULTICAST]. If empty, the group is joined on every adapter with a routable IPv4 address (link-local [code]169.254.x.x[/code] adapters are skipped) and the operating system picks the interface for sending. If set, only that adapter joins and it is also used for sending.
UDP port to listen on (1 to 65535). It is also the destination port unless [member destination_port] is set. DIS commonly uses 3000.

If [code]true[/code], the socket allows address reuse so that several DIS applications on one computer can listen on the same [member port]. Each receives broadcast and multicast traffic, but a unicast packet reaches only one of them. If [code]false[/code], [method start] fails when the port is taken.
Site number of this simulation (0 to 65535). See [member application_id].

signal.name: acknowledge_received
signal.description: Emitted after [signal pdu_received] for every received [DisAcknowledgePdu]. [param pdu] is the decoded PDU.

signal.name: collision_received
signal.description: Emitted after [signal pdu_received] for every received [DisCollisionPdu]. [param pdu] is the decoded PDU.

signal.name: comment_received
signal.description: Emitted after [signal pdu_received] for every received [DisCommentPdu]. [param pdu] is the decoded PDU.

signal.name: create_entity_received
signal.description: Emitted after [signal pdu_received] for every received [DisCreateEntityPdu]. [param pdu] is the decoded PDU.

signal.name: data_received
signal.description: Emitted after [signal pdu_received] for every received [DisDataPdu]. [param pdu] is the decoded PDU.

signal.name: detonation_received
signal.description: Emitted after [signal pdu_received] for every received [DisDetonationPdu]. [param pdu] is the decoded PDU.

signal.name: entity_state_received
signal.description: Emitted after [signal pdu_received] for every received [DisEntityStatePdu]. [param pdu] is the decoded PDU.

signal.name: fire_received
signal.description: Emitted after [signal pdu_received] for every received [DisFirePdu]. [param pdu] is the decoded PDU.

signal.name: packet_rejected
signal.description: Emitted when a packet is dropped because it is shorter than a PDU header, has an unsupported PDU type or cannot be decoded. [param reason] describes the problem; [param sender_ip] is the sender's address. Packets removed by the exercise or own-packet filters are not rejected, only counted as ignored.

signal.name: pdu_received
signal.description: Emitted for every PDU that passes the filters and decodes, before the PDU-specific signal. [param pdu] is the [DisPduBase] subclass matching the PDU type. [param sender_ip] and [param sender_port] identify the UDP sender (for injected packets, the values given to [method inject_packet]).

signal.name: remove_entity_received
signal.description: Emitted after [signal pdu_received] for every received [DisRemoveEntityPdu]. [param pdu] is the decoded PDU.

signal.name: set_data_received
signal.description: Emitted after [signal pdu_received] for every received [DisSetDataPdu]. [param pdu] is the decoded PDU.

signal.name: signal_received
signal.description: Emitted after [signal pdu_received] for every received [DisSignalPdu]. [param pdu] is the decoded PDU.

signal.name: start_resume_received
signal.description: Emitted after [signal pdu_received] for every received [DisStartResumePdu]. [param pdu] is the decoded PDU.

signal.name: stop_freeze_received
signal.description: Emitted after [signal pdu_received] for every received [DisStopFreezePdu]. [param pdu] is the decoded PDU.

signal.name: transmitter_received
signal.description: Emitted after [signal pdu_received] for every received [DisTransmitterPdu]. [param pdu] is the decoded PDU.

constants.constant: Sends to [member destination_address] (default [code]255.255.255.255[/code]) and receives everything arriving on [member port].
Sends to the single host [member destination_address] and receives everything arriving on [member port].
Joins [member multicast_group] and sends to it. Multicast loopback is on, so other applications on the same computer also receive the PDUs.
